title: Jacktol reproduction and ATCO2 gold study
scoring_contract: Final claims use standalone normalized WER: lowercase, Unicode diacritic folding, punctuation and symbol removal, and whitespace normalization. In-training validation WER is not used as the comparison of record. Jacktol validation, Jacktol test, UWB test, LibriSpeech test-clean, and the locked ATCO2 community test are distinct evaluation sets and are never treated as interchangeable.

references.training: Model card: Jacktol training, 16 epochs, batch 16, LR 1e-4, cosine schedule, 5,000 warmup steps, FP16.
references.note: The model card reports 5.99%. Our pinned local test produced 516 errors over 8,510 normalized reference words: 6.06%.

references.training: Model card: 3.25 epochs, LR 1e-5, batch 10, offline augmentation.
references.note: Included as a public reference only; we did not re-evaluate this checkpoint under our local Parakeet scoring run.

references.training: Reported staged recipe with Jacktol, LibriSpeech, and 30% synthetic Edge-radio data; LR 1e-5; 3,000 steps per rung.
references.note: The 6.27% Jacktol figure comes from the supplied reproduction bundle. Our separate local reconciliation scored this checkpoint on ATCO2 development and LibriSpeech, not Jacktol.

findings.title: The public Jacktol result was reproducible
findings.text: P2 reached 5.93% and P3 reached 5.91% on the pinned Jacktol test. The public qenneth checkpoint scored 6.06% with the same local scorer, closely matching its 5.99% model-card claim.

findings.title: The recipe was staged, not a one-shot fine-tune
findings.text: The large gain arrived through A1 and A2 with Jacktol, UWB, and English, followed by targeted P1–P3 polishing. A flat 20k-step emulation failed despite using matched Jacktol data.

findings.title: P2 is the balanced selection
findings.text: P3 removed only two additional Jacktol errors. P2 retained better UWB and LibriSpeech WER, making it the more defensible deployment checkpoint.

findings.title: Gold labels help most after broad domain adaptation
findings.text: G3 silver-to-gold refinement reached 20.00% on the locked ATCO2 community test, clearly outperforming direct gold-only G1 at 26.44%.

findings.title: Gold-only experiments expose forgetting
findings.text: Training the untouched model on only 0.418 hours of ATCO2 gold produced useful in-domain adaptation but raised LibriSpeech WER to 10.91%. English replay reduced that damage.

findings.title: ATCO2 gold can complement the Jacktol endpoint
findings.text: Adding 0.678 hours of leakage-safe ATCO2 gold to P2 improved ATCO2 WER from 17.79% to 15.44% while leaving Jacktol test at 5.93%. A later repair stage was too aggressive and was rejected.

findings.title: The community checkpoint transfers strongly, with an overlap caveat
findings.text: The unchanged qenneth checkpoint scored 15.91% on all 2.000 hours. After removing 213 segments tied to confirmed Jacktol source recordings, it scored 16.65% on 1.749 hours; this disjoint score is the cleaner estimate but uses a different subset.
